My rerun showed that the non-default reporter_mass_shift of 0.01 in run0 is not a fault. It is needed: with the default 0.002, ch2 and ch4 lose almost all their quantifications. The cause of the ratio compression is not established. My hypotheses are co-isolation interference (precursor purity filter off) and uncorrected TMT isotope impurities (isotope_correction false).
